newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MERSON RULED OUT OF GEORGIA GAME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MERSON RULED OUT OF GEORGIA GAME.

text.p: Paul Merson suffered a big setback to his revitalised international career when he was forced to withdraw from the England squad which flew out on Wednesday for Saturday's World Cup qualifier with Georgia.
The Arsenal midfielder, who has rebuilt his life after a series of drugs, drink and gambling problems, has failed to recover from a groin injury in time.
But England coach Glenn Hoddle, who has already lost Liverpool defender Dominic Matteo, decided not to call for any late replacements.

Merson's comeback to his old form had been rewarded by Hoddle with a recall to the international squad and with so much controversy hovering over Paul Gascoigne, the Arsenal man was in line to play some part in Tbilisi.
Merson's withdrawal and Hoddle's probable tactics of packing midfield now look likely to spell a reprieve for Gascoigne.
The coach's only other worry as the squad set off was goalkeeper David Seaman who is suffering from a "dead" leg. But Seaman insisted: "I expect to be back in training tomorrow."
